title: Square Enix H1 FY2027 results: operating income +42.2%, full-year forecast raised

sources.name: Square Enix Holdings, Consolidated Financial Results for the Six-Month Period Ended September 30, 2026 (11 Nov 2026)
Square Enix Holdings, Notice of Revisions to Full-Year Consolidated Financial Forecasts (11 Nov 2026)

first_report: Square Enix IR release 11 Nov 2026 (Tokyo afternoon, about 06:00Z); Famitsu 11:50Z first seen by the watch
footage: Steam store trailer 'EN ESRB - launch' of FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH (app 2909400), official, credited to Square Enix; the report names Rebirth for Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S and Windows as a driver

angle.hook: Square Enix's profit jumped and it raised its yearly forecast
angle.why_now: The company published its six-month results and a forecast revision today, 11 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Players see the money behind the Rebirth ports to Switch 2, Xbox and Windows and the catalog sales the company names
angle.payoff: Operating income forecast for the year to March 2027 goes from 49 to 59 billion yen

checked: gate 12:41Z: read both Square Enix IR PDFs in full (results and forecast notice: previous 298/49/49/31 bn yen, revised 310/59/59/37 bn), Famitsu headline and an Arabic outlet agree; no correction or denial found; twistedvoxel secondary matches the primary

claims.text: Net sales 163,179 m yen (+21.9%); operating income 38,793 m yen (+42.2%); profit attributable 28,566 m yen (+184.2%), six months to 30 Sep 2026
Full-year operating income forecast 59,000 m yen, previous 49,000 m yen
Digital Entertainment net sales 97,681 m yen (+33.7%) driven by Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S and Windows, The Adventures of Elliot and catalog
Dividend forecast unchanged: 18 yen interim, 25 yen year end
